faults.quote: (find) To find something that was lost or to discover something.
faults.why: 'Bertemu' means 'to meet'; 'to find' a lost object is 'menemukan' (or colloquial 'ketemu').

faults.quote: Akhirnya saya bertemu dompet yang hilang itu.
faults.why: Ungrammatical in Indonesian; 'bertemu' cannot mean finding an inanimate object like a wallet.
